name: rpg-engine
description: A toolbox that lets a high-level AI run a tabletop RPG campaign: the AI tells the story, the tool remembers, rolls the dice and keeps the accounts.

scripts.build: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc
scripts.docs: node --experimental-strip-types --input-type=module -e "import { writeFileSync } from 'node:fs'; import { commands } from './src/commands/index.ts'; import { commandReference } from './src/core/command-reference.ts'; writeFileSync('docs/commands.md', commandReference(commands));"

author: Stefano Caronia
